Filter 5,400 simulated building typologies by geometry, envelope, PV share, flexibility and heating system, and compare without a fixed selection limit. Filters and charts run directly in the browser, without a Python backend.

Gross floor area, plot area and the usable-area-weighted refurbishment share adjust contextual assessment. Original energy flows and GHG results remain unchanged. Original and adjusted assessments are shown separately. The Quick Check is a proof of concept for variant comparison, not a replacement for verification.

The same generated HTML file can be embedded in other Quarto projects. It includes data and Plotly in full; no second calculation implementation is needed.

**Bestand untersuchen** (explore the stock) offers primary-energy demand versus supply, heating/cooling-demand distributions and primary/final-energy balances versus floor-area ratio. Analyse all filter matches or selected scenarios. PE and GHG comparisons remain below. Above 100 selected scenarios, individual contributions use compact WebGL lines; the detail table is paginated.

The existing interactive explorer is embedded unchanged below; controls and chart labels remain in German.
